title: Meet your open strings
summary: Find low E2 and high E4, with a beat of silence between them.
goal: Play two open E strings at a steady pulse and leave the rests quiet.
body:
Before starting: have your guitar ready and know which end of the strings is thickest. No fretting experience is needed.

An open string rings without pressing a fret. String 6 is the thickest and sounds E2 in Standard tuning. String 1 is the thinnest and sounds E4. They share the name E, but E4 is two octaves higher.

Select Standard in Instrument settings and physically tune your guitar before practicing. Use a clean, comfortable sound. The numbers on tablature identify frets: 0 means an open string.

In Standard tuning, strings 6 → 1 are E2, A2, D3, G3, B3, E4. The octave number distinguishes low and high notes. This course uses Standard with A4 = 440 Hz. In the tuner, select a string, pluck it alone, and gently adjust its tuning machine until the pitch settles near the target. Selecting a tuning in the app does not tune the guitar.

For an electric guitar, select the interface and its guitar input channel in Audio setup. Choose Acoustic guitar · Microphone or Acoustic guitar · Pickup when that is your source. Keep the sound clean and use headphones for the metronome. Start this exercise at 60 BPM; 40 BPM is available if you need more time.

Practice begins with a short signal check and a count-in. After the attempt, open the result and prepare a suggested repeat. Without reliable timing calibration, the app can give pitch feedback while rhythm and the overall score remain unavailable. Listen to the written rests yourself: this version checks note pitch and new attacks, not how long every note rings.

hear-low-e.title: 1. Hear the low E
hear-low-e.body: On beat 1, pluck string 6 without pressing a fret. Listen to E2. One relaxed pluck is enough.

leave-space.title: 2. Leave a beat of silence
leave-space.body: Beat 2 is a rest. Gently stop the low string with a comfortable touch and keep counting. Do not pluck another note.

hear-high-e.title: 3. Hear the high E
hear-high-e.body: On beat 3, pluck open string 1. It sounds E4, two octaves above the low E. You do not need to press the fingerboard.

play-the-bar.title: 4. Put the four beats together
play-the-bar.body: Count 1, 2, 3, 4: low E, rest, high E, rest. Start at 60 BPM or choose a slower tempo. Aim for a clear note on each playing beat and silence on each rest.
